data.body: ARCHITECTURE PIVOT (2026-06-04, ADR-0022, supersedes ADR-0021 + the HMAC-ledger). Maintainer direction: the bypass-actor is a designated human admin merging via the GitHub UI; no persistent admin PAT. The HMAC-signed ledger (requires someone to SIGN each exemption) is replaced by an IDENTITY-BASED exemption: a SHA is reviewed-equivalent iff its covering merged PR's merged_by.id is in the configured bypass-actor SET (ruleset.bypass_user_ids, default = ruleset.bypass_user_id). Forge-proof by construction: the agent is current_user_can_bypass:never -> cannot merge a failing PR -> cannot be merged_by on a bypass; merged_by is server-set. Satisfies the v4/2730 anti-self-attestation lesson by a STRONGER means (no key to police). 3-lens panel (accuracy/historical/fitness) + convergence review -> APPROVED/converged, no integrity regression (all failure modes fail CLOSED), net deletion of the HMAC subsystem. RETIRES: admin-exemption-ledger.sh, fp-recovery-record-exemption.sh, .admin-exemption-ledger (inert, 0 rows, not on main), DSO_ADMIN_EXEMPTION_KEY_FILE/gap G-A, C1/C2/C3, P-AEL/P-AEL-PROVENANCE, the two-tier ordering precondition. ADDS: merged_by.id read in the 2 covering-PR filters + merged_by∈set check replacing ael_sha_is_exempt at the 2 gates; bypass set config; merged_by in the audit sweep; P-IDENTITY-EXEMPT liveness gate (drives the production filter, both polarities). TRADE-OFF (explicit): C1 'cleared review before bypass' moves from preventive (code-enforced) to detective (annotation + non-blocking audit sweep) — accepted (trusted-human bypass-actor). NEXT: implement (TDD). Also update 3ee4 P8c prereq item 3 (S-11 ledger -> identity-based).
